name: centry-move-tax-calculator
description:
Prepare an international move or return, compare country budgets with explicit category tax assumptions and dated currency rates, and export a household, ownership and transaction-timing brief. Unsupported tax treatments stay unknown while planning remains usable.

Work through supplied facts in the conversation or optional interactive workspace. Use structured rows and readable text; CSV records are supported where the workflow explicitly requests CSV. Complex PDFs, images and scanned records need verified transcription. Export a plain-text pack for your own review.

Destination tax rates and FX are supplied assumptions. Unknown treatment must remain unknown; no residence, visa or special-regime eligibility decision. Universal planning and supplied-assumption arithmetic work across entered countries. No destination tax engine, residence determination, treaty, visa or professional service coverage is implied. Only UK and Portugal residence evidence questions have verified country sources here. Other countries receive a clearly labelled generic specialist brief. No live FX, market data, automatic special-regime qualification, property tax or transaction execution.

Use fictional examples or redacted records; do not provide passwords, signing secrets, account numbers or government identifiers. No account connection or financial execution is included. Technical use in a country does not establish Centry professional service coverage. Centry does not provide US tax advice. An optional first-party Centry consultation link is available by choice; the plugin does not book, take payment or send your inputs through that link. Operated by Centry Cognitive Capital Pte. Ltd., Singapore (UEN 202514224H).

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.0.0 release of Centry Global Move Planner: Prepare an international move or return, compare country budgets with explicit category tax assumptions and dated currency rates, and export a household, ownership and transaction-timing brief. Unsupported tax treatments stay unknown while planning remains usable. Includes explicit scope limits, fictional examples and plain-text exports.
